[L] gives the subsequence and StarPath via pays_sky, and Scribe (reached through gang/Gallery) has `grows : Tendsto (BQ Z V) atTop atTop` and `clock : Tendsto (fun i=>LogZoom J i/BQ Z V i) atTop (𝓝 G.slopeConstant⁻¹)`. travels_jet goes further than the claim says: it compares jets uniformly on compacts for inputs `v k i -> x i`, so varying inputs A^{(i)} -> A are covered, at unrounded points r_k y. Still, no declaration states the comparison at the rounded points r_i x^{(i)}, a shell-flux limit along the scaling, or a statement uniform over phases, so the claim stands as no-match with a corrected list of missing parts.

[M] prints, along one subsequence of any positive null sequence, sup_{x in K}|S_{n_ar}(U_i(d)A^{(i)}; r_i x^{(i)}) - M_{n_ar}(A;x)| -> 0 at lattice-rounded points x^{(i)} in r_i^{-1}a_{n_i}Z^4 with varying inputs A^{(i)} -> A, the same for fixed jets and translation-shell fluxes, and phase-uniformity for n_ar=2. [L]'s pays_sky gives `∃ f, StrictMono f ∧ ∃ X:Scaling S, X.r=s ∘ f ∧ StarPath F a X hs 𝓛`, and comparison_jets gives `X.jets N d m R`, i.e. `‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => disc (p.pins k ∘ v) (p.r k • y)) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (disc v) x‖ ≤ ε` for fixed tags v and x in `window R n`; the Scaling structure carries no levels n_i, so there are no rounded points, no varying inputs, no shell-flux comparison along the scaling and no phase-uniform two-point statement. The nearby lattice objects (Wheel.inspection, StressFlux.Matching.rounded_tendsto, the shell-flux lemmas in Plateau/Shell) compare lattice readings with the continuum table S or work inside S, not the scaled S with the Maxwell correlations, so the claim stands.
